items.label: TTB administrative: Smith & Wesson Sales Company
items.detail: TTB accepted an offer in compromise of $1,729,000 (submitted with the offer) against $3,544,031.28 of alleged federal excise tax liability for unsupported promotional-program and consumer-rebate tax treatment in Springfield MA; date is the acceptance signature date; the abstract says the company allegedly failed and does not state an admission; scanned PDF read as a rendered page.
